environment.ordinaryTests: Public raster tiles and Google Fonts CSS stubbed; actual local production JS, CSS, bundled map data, localStorage and IndexedDB exercised.
environment.realNetworkTest: Separate approved read-only public-network run; after save success and return to new Explore map, 8 OpenStreetMap HTTP 200 responses and 8 loaded images with naturalWidth > 0; loading and retry notices absent.

runs.detail: One harness selector omitted expanding the collapsed landmark list after refresh. Product progress was correct. Public network smoke opts in separately.
Corrected landmark selector; IndexedDB photos decoded after refresh; precise 250m and 100m accuracy thresholds; three navigation regressions with final console hooks.
New map after check-in reached fully decoded detailed tiles. All tests ran on the same unchanged production build.

scenarioGroups.group: Service worker offline and failure recovery

limitations: Browser simulation only: no physical phone, real GPS, real camera, field arrival or candidate boundary calibration.
No cloud synchronization or production deployment exercised.
Offline behavior requires successful prior shell caching; remote detailed map tiles are intentionally not cached.
Expected injected network failures and deliberate Playwright service-worker-block warning are documented; no uncaught application errors were observed.
